issues.unknownLocale: The language “{locale}” is not set up.
issues.badStep: “{label}” does not fit the step size {step}.
issues.notMoney: “{label}” must be an amount in cents.
issues.notWeekStart: “{label}” must be the first day of a week.
issues.notIdList: “{label}” must be a list of entry IDs.
issues.altMissing: “{label}”: The image description (alt text) is missing.
issues.fileRefMissing: “{label}”: An image in the text is no longer in the Files library. Choose it again.
issues.fileRefPdf: A PDF cannot be shown as a picture. Link it instead: [text]($file.…).
issues.markdownImageAltMissing: “{label}”: An image in the text has no description. Describe it briefly for people who cannot see it.

file.typeNotAllowed: This file type is not allowed (allowed: {allowed}).
file.tooBig: The file is too large (at most {max, number} MB).

profile.inline: only text with bold, italic, code and links
profile.basic: paragraphs, headings, lists (also with checkboxes), quotes, notices and footnotes
profile.rich: also tables, images, code blocks, formulas and diagrams

markdown.unsafeLink: Link is not allowed (only http, https, mailto, tel or /path).
markdown.oneParagraph: Only one paragraph is allowed here.
markdown.tooComplex: Text is too complex (at most {max} elements).
markdown.componentNotClosed: The component “{tag}” is not closed: a line with “{close}” is missing after its content.
markdown.bracketText: “[{text}” is neither a link nor an image: a “]” or the address in round brackets is missing. Square brackets as text: \[ and \].

component.blockInParagraph: Component “{tag}” is a block and does not belong in a paragraph.
component.noSlots: Component “{tag}”: has no areas, “{slot}” is not allowed.

prop.badStep: does not fit the step size {step}.
prop.badImage: must be a path or a web address.
prop.badType: has a type that is not allowed.

links.snippetMissing: Text snippet “{name}” not found (entry snippets/{name} with field body).
links.linkBroken: Link {href} leads to no entry and no page.
links.linkRedirected: Link {href} leads to {to} through a redirect.
links.pathUnknown: Path {path} matches no entry, no page and no file in public/.
links.fileBroken: File {file} ({label}) is missing or not processed yet.
links.anchorMissing: Anchor #{anchor} is missing: no heading with this id.

source.unstable: The text would change when saved, so it is edited as Markdown.
source.lossy: The text cannot be shown in the editor without losing something.
source.failed: The text cannot be shown in the editor ({reason}).

diff.siteRenamed: The site name (`site`) cannot be changed.
diff.currencyChanged: The site currency cannot be changed.
diff.mainLocaleChanged: The main language cannot be changed.
diff.localeOrder: New languages go at the end of the list.
diff.timezoneChanged: The time zone cannot be changed.
diff.retiredBack: “{path}” was retired and cannot come back.
diff.retiredRuleChanged: The rule for “{path}” cannot be changed.
diff.migrationDropped: Migration “{id}” is no longer in the config.
diff.singleWithoutDefault: New single: required field “{name}” needs a default.
diff.unknownChange: “{at}”: property “{prop}” changed, which is not allowed.
diff.fieldAddedMigration: New required field “{at}”, filled by a migration.
diff.requiredWithoutDefault: New required field “{at}” without default or migration.
diff.retiredFieldChanged: “{at}”: a retired field keeps its production definition.
diff.minOffGrid: “{at}”: min can only be lowered by a multiple of the step {step}.
diff.uniqueChanged: “{at}”: unique cannot be set or changed.

fix.newField: Add a new field, fill it with a migration and list the old field under `retired`.
fix.moneyFields: Add new money fields with a fixed `currency`.
fix.planMigration: Plan a migration with your developer.
fix.keepLocale: Keep the language; pages in it can be hidden.
fix.keepLocaleOrder: Keep the order of the existing languages.
fix.keepRule: Leave the rule as it is.
fix.newMigrationId: A repair gets a new ID.
fix.fillNewFieldsOnly: Fill only new fields; for an existing one, add a new field.
fix.retireBrick: List the brick under `retired` instead of deleting it.
fix.defaultOrOptional: Set a `default` or make the field optional.
fix.defaultMigrationOrOptional: Set a `default`, write a migration or make the field optional.
fix.keepDefinition: Leave the definition as it is; only texts may change.
fix.minOnGrid: Lower min so that the difference is a multiple of step.
fix.keepOption: Keep the option; it can be renamed (label).
fix.newList: Add a new list and fill it with a migration.
fix.factInUse: Take the fact out of these texts first, or keep it in `facts`.

diff.factInUse: The fact “{fact}” is missing from `facts` but is still quoted in {count, plural, one {one text} other {# texts}}: {texts}.
